Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.Name: Factory
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.Name: SyncName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the object that we will try and resolve so it can be synced.

Property.Name: ChangePackagesToRemove
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The list of Change Packages to be unassigned from the Modeling Instance

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ChangePackageToAssign
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A change package is used to manage what is delivered to a target system for consumption.

Property.Name: CIOIsSync
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO - Indicates that the Sync method is being called.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. This field was introduced because the XMLAppServer supports only stateless services. This field should not be used in a stateful environment like DCOM AppServer.

Property.Name: ESigDetails-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ESigRequirement
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: TxnDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Property.Name: WhereUsed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A list of this type is returned by the Where-used functionality of a maintenance service. An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: CIOMessageContents
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Message Contents from the CIO Message Service

Property.Name: CIOMessageID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: GUID representing a CIO Message - inbound

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOClienbtGatewayPostTimeout
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The amount of time in seconds to wait for a POST to the client gateway. Set by OGV.

Property.Name: CIOClientGatewayURL
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOClientGatewayURL generated by CLF

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: User

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.Name: CIOIsSync
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO - Indicates that the Sync method is being called.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: WhereUsed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A list of this type is returned by the Where-used functionality of a maintenance service. Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: ServerName

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is the entity that is currently being maintained

Property.Name: CompletionMsg
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: When the service is executed, this field will be filled out by the system with a message in the terminology of the user and language that describes the successful completion of the service, or describes the error condition if there was an error. The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.Name: Factory
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.Name: SyncName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the object that we will try and resolve so it can be synced.

Property.Name: ChangePackagesToRemove
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The list of Change Packages to be unassigned from the Modeling Instance

Property.Name: ChangePackagesToRemove-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ChangePackageToAssign
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A change package is used to manage what is delivered to a target system for consumption.

Property.Name: CIOIsSync
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO - Indicates that the Sync method is being called.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. This field was introduced because the XMLAppServer supports only stateless services. This field should not be used in a stateful environment like DCOM AppServer.

Property.Name: ESigDetails-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ESigRequirement
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: TxnDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Property.Name: WhereUsed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A list of this type is returned by the Where-used functionality of a maintenance service. An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: CIOMessageContents
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Message Contents from the CIO Message Service

Property.Name: CIOMessageID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: GUID representing a CIO Message - inbound

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOClienbtGatewayPostTimeout
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The amount of time in seconds to wait for a POST to the client gateway. Set by OGV.

Property.Name: CIOClientGatewayURL
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOClientGatewayURL generated by CLF

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Indicates that thr message is a Get wiith no execute. Used for outbound messages

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: InSite Unified Expression

Property.Name: DisplayName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element. For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object. The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used. DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

Property.Name: CompletionMsg
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: When the service is executed, this field will be filled out by the system with a message in the terminology of the user and language that describes the successful completion of the service, or describes the error condition if there was an error. The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the object that we will try and resolve so it can be synced.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The list of Change Packages to be unassigned from the Modeling Instance

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A change package is used to manage what is delivered to a target system for consumption.

Property.Name: CIOIsSync
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO - Indicates that the Sync method is being called.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. This field was introduced because the XMLAppServer supports only stateless services. This field should not be used in a stateful environment like DCOM AppServer.

Property.Name: ESigDetails-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ESigRequirement
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: TxnDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Property.Name: WhereUsed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A list of this type is returned by the Where-used functionality of a maintenance service. An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: CIOMessageContents
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Message Contents from the CIO Message Service

Property.Name: CIOMessageID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: GUID representing a CIO Message - inbound

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOClienbtGatewayPostTimeout
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The amount of time in seconds to wait for a POST to the client gateway. Set by OGV.

Property.Name: CIOClientGatewayURL
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOClientGatewayURL generated by CLF

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Indicates that thr message is a Get wiith no execute. Used for outbound messages

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is the entity that is currently being maintained

Property.Name: CompletionMsg
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: When the service is executed, this field will be filled out by the system with a message in the terminology of the user and language that describes the successful completion of the service, or describes the error condition if there was an error. The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.Name: Factory
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.Name: SyncName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the object that we will try and resolve so it can be synced.

Property.Name: ChangePackagesToRemove
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The list of Change Packages to be unassigned from the Modeling Instance

Property.Name: ChangePackagesToRemove-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ChangePackageToAssign
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A change package is used to manage what is delivered to a target system for consumption.

Property.Name: CIOIsSync
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO - Indicates that the Sync method is being called.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. This field was introduced because the XMLAppServer supports only stateless services. This field should not be used in a stateful environment like DCOM AppServer.

Property.Name: ESigDetails-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ESigRequirement
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: TxnDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Property.Name: WhereUsed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A list of this type is returned by the Where-used functionality of a maintenance service. An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: CIOMessageContents
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Message Contents from the CIO Message Service

Property.Name: CIOMessageID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: GUID representing a CIO Message - inbound

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOClienbtGatewayPostTimeout
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The amount of time in seconds to wait for a POST to the client gateway. Set by OGV.

Property.Name: CIOClientGatewayURL
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOClientGatewayURL generated by CLF

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object. The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: CIOMessageContents
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Message Contents from the CIO Message Service

Property.Name: CIOMessageID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: GUID representing a CIO Message - inbound

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOClienbtGatewayPostTimeout
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The amount of time in seconds to wait for a POST to the client gateway. Set by OGV.

Property.Name: CIOClientGatewayURL
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOClientGatewayURL generated by CLF

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.Name: CIOIsGet
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Indicates that thr message is a Get wiith no execute. Used for outbound messages

Property.Name: CIOListExpression
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: InSite Unified Expression

Property.Name: CIOListProcessorName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Request Data - result of request expressions

Property.Name: CIORequestDataExps

Property.Name: CIOSendMsgToExternalSystemResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOSendMsgToExternalSystemResult is the boolean value true or false depending on execution of custom proc SendMsgToExternalSystem.

Property.Name: CIOSerialRequests
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Used to request Serialized objects in a reponse

Property.Name: CIOSerialResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOSerialResult - used as Proxy for SerialRequests

Property.Name: CIOSerialResults
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Serial Results - OGV to serialize CIOSerialRequests

Property.Name: CIOSynchTimeout

Property.Name: DisplayName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element. For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object. The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used. DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO - Indicates that the Sync method is being called.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.Name: CompletionMsg

The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.Name: Factory
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the object that we will try and resolve so it can be synced.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ChangePackageToAssign

Property.Name: CIOIsSync
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO - Indicates that the Sync method is being called.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. This field was introduced because the XMLAppServer supports only stateless services. This field should not be used in a stateful environment like DCOM AppServer.

Property.Name: ESigDetails-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ESigRequirement
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: TxnDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Property.Name: WhereUsed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A list of this type is returned by the Where-used functionality of a maintenance service. An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Message Contents from the CIO Message Service

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: GUID representing a CIO Message - inbound

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOClientGatewayURL

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Indicates that thr message is a Get wiith no execute. Used for outbound messages

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element. For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object. The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used. DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.
