Property.customAttribute:Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element. For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object. The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used. DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is the entity that is currently being maintained

Property.Name: CompletionMsg
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: When the service is executed, this field will be filled out by the system with a message in the terminology of the user and language that describes the successful completion of the service, or describes the error condition if there was an error. The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.Name: Factory
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.Name: SyncName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the object that we will try and resolve so it can be synced.

Property.Name: ChangePackagesToRemove
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The list of Change Packages to be unassigned from the Modeling Instance

Property.Name: ChangePackagesToRemove-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ChangePackageToAssign
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A change package is used to manage what is delivered to a target system for consumption.

Property.Name: CIOIsSync
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO - Indicates that the Sync method is being called.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. This field was introduced because the XMLAppServer supports only stateless services. This field should not be used in a stateful environment like DCOM AppServer.

Property.Name: ESigDetails-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ESigRequirement
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: TxnDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Property.Name: WhereUsed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A list of this type is returned by the Where-used functionality of a maintenance service. An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: CIOMessageContents
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Message Contents from the CIO Message Service

Property.Name: CIOMessageID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: GUID representing a CIO Message - inbound

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOClienbtGatewayPostTimeout
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The amount of time in seconds to wait for a POST to the client gateway. Set by OGV.

Property.Name: CIOClientGatewayURL
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOClientGatewayURL generated by CLF

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.Name: CIOIsGet
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Indicates that thr message is a Get wiith no execute. Used for outbound messages

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: InSite Unified Expression

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Request Data - result of request expressions

Property.Name: CIORequestDataExps
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Request Data Expressions are used to request data to be returned in an Outbound Response

Property.Name: CIOSendMsgToExternalSystemResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOSendMsgToExternalSystemResult is the boolean value true or false depending on execution of custom proc SendMsgToExternalSystem.

Property.Name: CIOSerialRequests
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Used to request Serialized objects in a reponse

Property.Name: CIOSerialResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOSerialResult - used as Proxy for SerialRequests

Property.Name: CIOSerialResults
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Serial Results - OGV to serialize CIOSerialRequests

Property.Name: CIOSynchTimeout

Property.Name: CIOTagData

Property.Name: DisplayName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element. For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object. The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used. DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: CIOMessageContents
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Message Contents from the CIO Message Service

Property.Name: CIOMessageID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: GUID representing a CIO Message - inbound

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOClienbtGatewayPostTimeout
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The amount of time in seconds to wait for a POST to the client gateway. Set by OGV.

Property.Name: CIOClientGatewayURL
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOClientGatewayURL generated by CLF

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.Name: CIOIsGet
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Indicates that thr message is a Get wiith no execute. Used for outbound messages

The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A list of this type is returned by the Where-used functionality of a maintenance service. An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOClienbtGatewayPostTimeout
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The amount of time in seconds to wait for a POST to the client gateway. Set by OGV.

Property.Name: CIOClientGatewayURL
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOClientGatewayURL generated by CLF

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CompletionMsg
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: When the service is executed, this field will be filled out by the system with a message in the terminology of the user and language that describes the successful completion of the service, or describes the error condition if there was an error. The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.Name: Factory

Property.Name: ChangePackagesToRemove-Expanded

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO - Indicates that the Sync method is being called.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. This field was introduced because the XMLAppServer supports only stateless services. This field should not be used in a stateful environment like DCOM AppServer.

Property.Name: ESigDetails-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ESigRequirement
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: WhereUsed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A list of this type is returned by the Where-used functionality of a maintenance service. An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee

Property.Name: IsRemoteService

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery

Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: ClearToWorkflowStack
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This flag is used when the ToWorkflowStack list field is meant to be cleared.

Property.Name: FromStep
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The step the trackable object is leaving.

Property.Name: NavigationMode
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Workflow navigation mode determines whether to use a regular Path or a ReworkPath during Move transactions. Possible navigational modes are: Standard = 1 Rework = 2

Property.Name: Path
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A Path defines an allowable (Standard) move from one Step to another within a Workflow. If a path is entered here, this path will override any information entered on the "Step" field. If no path or step is provided, pathselectors for the step will be evaluated to determine which path will be used. If no path selectors are valid, the container will be moved to the step referenced by the default path in the workflow.

Property.Name: Spec
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This spec is used by the OverrideCurrentStatus function.

Property.Name: Step
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This object refers to the Workflow Step where the container is currently at and being moved from.

Property.Name: ToSpecStep
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Steps are used to discretely define processing for a point (step) within a Workflow. A Workflow is a collection of Steps that are related using Paths. Each Step contains zero or more Paths, which link to another Step. One Path at each Step is identified as the default Path.
A sequence of Steps and Paths is a Route. A Workflow can include multiple Routes. Only one Route is identified as the Standard Route. The Standard Route is determined by starting with the Step that is identified as the first Step and then iterating forward selecting the default path at each step.
A Specification Step is a step within a Workflow that includes a reference to a Spec which in turn describes the work that is to be performed.

Property.Name: ToStep
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This object refers to the Workflow Step where the container is being moved to. If a path is provided, the path will override any information entered here. If no path or step is provided, pathselectors for the step will be evaluated to determine which path will be used. If no path selectors are valid, the container will be moved to the step referenced by the default path in the workflow.

Property.Name: ToWorkflow
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The workflow containing the ToStep to move to

Property.Name: ToWorkflowStack
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is the stack of subworkflow steps that lead to the current spec step.

Property.Name: WorkflowNavigator
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Navigate through a workflow, including subworkflows and rework information.

Property.Name: WorkflowStack
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This is the stack of subworkflow steps that lead to the current spec step.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Activity Type

Property.Name: ApprovalSheetTemplate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: An approval sheet is used to collect signatures of approvers who are making decisions regarding the status of an object. The template is used to pre-define the sheets that will be attached to the object.

Property.Name: AuditTrail
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Modeling Audit Trail Header encapsulates the header information captured during every modeling data object maintenance

Property.Name: BusinessRule
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Business Rule that will be added to the list specified in RuleList.

Property.Name: ChecklistTemplate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Checklist Template object allows the user to configure checklist items/questions and associate each item with the appropriate Response Set.

Property.Name: MaintenanceType
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the maintenance service type.

Property.Name: ObjectToChange
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Use this field to specify what process object to change or delete.

Property.Name: ParentDataObject
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Specifies the parent of the object to be created.

Property.Name: Phase
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A phase describes the general stages that a Quality object goes through during processing.

Property.Name: PhaseTemplate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A template of a Phase. A phase describes different stages of the process, e.g. Triage, Investigation, Implementation, Review.

Property.Name: Plan
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The plan to change.

Property.Name: PlanTemplate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A template of Plan, which is a list of acivities used to process the Quality object.

Property.Name: ProcessModel
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A process model describes what needs to be done to resolve the issue reported as a Quality Object

Property.Name: ProcessModelDetails
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The details field is used to pull details from the Quality Object.

Property.Name: ProcessModelTemplate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A template of the Process object that describes the processing needed for a Quality Object

Property.Name: RuleList
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the field to which the Business Rule will be copied.

Property.Name: Template
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The template to copy from

Property.Name: TriageComplete
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The flag is used to determine if the QualityTxn have to update value in QualityObject

NavigationProperty.Name: ExecuteChecklist
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Execute Checklist transaction is used to complete assigned checklist.

NavigationProperty.Name: ObjectChanges
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: This holds the changes that need to be made.

NavigationProperty.Name: ProcessObjectMaint
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Used to maintain process object subentities

Property.Name: Carrier
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A carrier is a physical entity that holds material which is used in batch processing. Carriers are resources like: Vessels, Vats, drums, trays etc.

Property.Name: Container
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A Container describes a discrete unit of work or a discrete quantity of material (i.e., batch of material, a serialized component or serialized piece of material, a uniquely identified package or vessel that contains product, etc.) A Container can include quantity information (weight, count, etc.) directly, or it can include a grouping of other containers (child containers).

Property.Name: Operation
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
An Operation is a manufacturing or processing point where inventory and production activities are tracked. The Operation describes such things as the reason codes, the work center, and the allowed transactions for the movement of material through a workflow step. In contrast, specifications define the specific processing that is performed at an operation.
The Operation also provides the general rules for the process and provides a general reporting construct. An Operation is referenced by a specification at a workflow step.

Property.Name: ReprintReason
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user code for reprint reason.

Property.Name: ReprintReasonRequired
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field is used to retrieve factory's ReprintReasonRequired value.

Property.Name: WorkCenter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
A work center is typically an area where work of a similar nature is performed. A work Center contains zero or more operations.
The work center is the component through which scheduling is performed through InSite. Scheduling can be conducted according to either employees or resources. A work center may have multiple operations if the operations are sharing employees, resources, or both. For example, an operation called Grind and an operation called Polish both use the same resources so they point to the same work center for scheduling purposes. There can also be one operation to one work center.

NavigationProperty.Name: CurrentContainerStatus
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Current status information of a Container

Property.Name: ResourceStatusCode
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
A Resource Status Code is provides a description of the current availability for a Resource. This value is used for inquiry and in reporting. (Mean Time Between Failure, Mean Time to Repair, Time at Status, etc.).
Additionally, a Resource Status code identifies the default “Next” (Production) Transaction for a Resource. This is intended to be a simple implementation of a Resource Status Flow (Resource Workflow).

Property.Name: ResourceStatusReason
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A Resource Status Reason Code is used to provide an added level of detail describing the reason for the current status of a Resource. For example, the current status may be REPAIR. A Status Reason Code can be used to provide additional details such as the type of repair that is being performed. This detail is included in the transaction history, which makes it available for Analysis Reporting.

Property.Name: Spec
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and processing parameter information. A Spec is referenced (used) by a Step within a Workflow. Many Workflow Steps can use one Spec.
A Spec is used to define the processing that is to be performed. An Operation is used to define (rules for) the flow or movement of Material through the Factory.
See the Operation Definition for Scheduling Details information.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This CDO tracks the current version of any defect associated with a container. When the isDefect service or a subclass is used to add a defect, a new version of a defect, or resolve as defect it updates the isCurrentDefect values on the container

Property.Name: isDisplayAllChildDefects
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Used to trigger if a parent container is selected if all of the child containers defects are returned along with the parent containers defects.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Lot code or Container name for the component being replaced during the repair service

Property.Name: isMaterialListItemSettings
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Holds default information for the Component Issue Light transaction's Material List

Property.Name: isOldDefectHistoryDetail
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Keep track of history details of defect details

Property.Name: isRemovalReason
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The reason material was removed from a WIP container

Property.Name: isReplaceComponent
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: When checked the system will perform a quantity only issue for the component product being replaced.

Property.Name: isReplaceProduct
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
A Product is typically a definition of what kind of material needs to be provided to a customer or what kind of material is being used as a raw material or other component in a manufacturing process. Products can belong to a Product Family. A product to be manufactured will have an associated Workflow. Attributes of the Workflow may be overridden to be product specific.
Optionally, a Product can belong to a Product Family. A Product Family is used to group products for the purpose of simplifying the maintenance task (for modeling data). Common attributes such as costing or processing information can then be provided for a Product Family and applied to each Product within the family.

Property.Name: isReplaceQty
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Quantity to be replaced during repair operation

Property.Name: isTxnExecute
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: To Indicate whether it was add open or add repair to a defect

NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: A lighter, faster version of ComponentIssue

NavigationProperty.Name: isComponentRemove
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: The Component Remove transaction provides the ability to indicate any manufacturing situation, where component materials are separated from their WIP product . Scrap, Return to Stock and Component transfers between Containers are examples of why a component might be removed.

NavigationProperty.Name: isCurrentDefects
NavigationProperty.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of defects for a container. If the container is parent container and isDisplayAllChildDefect flag is turned on, it should list all defects for the parent container and also for the child containers. Else it only display the defects for that container.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bypass Expiration Check

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This field is a flag, defining is catch errors in process set-up the field QtyRequired from the RecipeIssueItem.RecipeMaterialListItem.

Property.Name: FEFOFlag
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The FEFOFlag is used to control the order in which Containers can be consumed. The first to expire must be the first used. This is used for RecipeIssues.

Property.Name: MasterRecipe
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The MasterRecipe is used to record the recipe to which the issue instructions are assigned.

Property.Name: MaterialList
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The MaterialList is a working field used to store the current issue instructions which are being executed.

Property.Name: OverrideUOMMismatch
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Override UOM Mismatch

Property.Name: RecipeIssueItem
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: One of the three possible types of Tasks in a RecipeList, this is a new TaskItem type. A RecipeIssueItem is used to define a component material to be issued to a RecipeList's Target Container.

Property.Name: RecipeList
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The equivalent of TaskList for MasterRecipe.

Property.Name: Spec
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and processing parameter information. A Spec is referenced (used) by a Step within a Workflow. Many Workflow Steps can use one Spec.
A Spec is used to define the processing that is to be performed. An Operation is used to define (rules for) the flow or movement of Material through the Factory.
See the Operation Definition for Scheduling Details information.

Property.Name: UseMaterialFromBatch
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Use Material From Batch

Property.Name: EndReworkStep
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The step at which the current rework ends

Property.Name: EndReworkWorkflow
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The workflow associated with the EndRework step.

Property.Name: isReworkReasonName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Readable name ov a Rework Reason Name

Property.Name: ReEntryStep
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ReEntry Step for Rework. This would be step to go to if the Move type transactions cannot determine the next step.

Property.Name: ReEntryWorkflow
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The workflow associated with the ReEntry step.

Property.Name: ReEntryWorkflowStack
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The workflow stack to use when reentering the main workflow.

Property.Name: ReworkReason
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: An instance of a Process Rework Code is used to provide a list of reasons for Process Rework. The code is associated with a Container when it enters a rework loop. It is then associated with all throughput transactions generated by the container while it is in the rework loop. This provides, for example, a means of differentiating between first pass and rework throughput in reporting.

Property.Name: UseReEntryWorkflowStack
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Determines whether the reentryworkflowstack is set from the service or the container. Defaults from the container.

Property.Name: AllowManualWeightEntryOverride
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Flag used to determine if a user is allowed to override the weight received from the scale. If true the user can override the scale's weight.

Property.Name: DecimalScale
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic Integer

Property.Name: ExpressionDependsOnFromContainer
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Boolean field when true the expressions for the Target, Minimum, and Maximum quantity will not be calculated until the issued From Container has been set. This only applies if the issue type is Bulk.

Property.Name: IsToleranceOverrideAllowed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Identified whether validation of the tolerances may be overridden. If overridden the validations around the tolerances will be ignored.

Property.Name: ManualWeightEntry
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Boolean when true flags the weight will be manually entered. Used for volumetric measurements or when the scale cannot be connected to a computer.

Property.Name: ManualWeightOverrideEsignature
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ESignature requirement required for Manual Weight override entry.

Property.Name: MatchByProductName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Boolean field used to determine if the user should match by name or actual revision.

Property.Name: MaterialFromSameContainer
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Flag that when checked validates that multiple issues of the same material are from the same Container or Lot

Property.Name: MaximumQuantityAllowed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expression used to calculate the maximum acceptable weight. This expression takes precedence over expression defined on the product or the material list item.

Property.Name: MinimumQuantityAllowed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expression used to calculate the minimum acceptable weight. This expression takes precedence over expression defined on the product or the material list item.

Property.Name: Product
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Product to weigh. This will be used to match the material list item.

Property.Name: QuantityAdditive
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Boolean when set to true updates the Batch Containers quantity with the issued products quantity.

Property.Name: RequiredQuantityExpression
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expression used to calculate the required weight. This expression takes precedence over expression defined on the product or the material list item.

Property.Name: RoundingRule
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: 1 = Round Down (Floor) 2 = Round Up (Ceiling) 3 = Round to Nearest

Property.Name: ScaleGroup
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: List of scale groups that can be used to weigh this material. This definition takes precedence over the scale group defined on the Spec, Product or Product Family.

Property.Name: ToleranceOverrideEsignature
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Esignature requirement required when Tolerance overrides are allowed

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The list of Change Packages to be unassigned from the Modeling Instance

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ChangePackageToAssign
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A change package is used to manage what is delivered to a target system for consumption.

Property.Name: CIOIsSync
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO - Indicates that the Sync method is being called.

Property.Name: CompletionMsg
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: When the service is executed, this field will be filled out by the system with a message in the terminology of the user and language that describes the successful completion of the service, or describes the error condition if there was an error. The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. This field was introduced because the XMLAppServer supports only stateless services. This field should not be used in a stateful environment like DCOM AppServer.

Property.Name: ESigDetails-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ESigRequirement
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: Factory
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.Name: SyncName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the object that we will try and resolve so it can be synced.

Property.Name: TxnDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Property.Name: WhereUsed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A list of this type is returned by the Where-used functionality of a maintenance service. An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: CIOMessageContents
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Message Contents from the CIO Message Service

Property.Name: CIOMessageID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: GUID representing a CIO Message - inbound

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOClienbtGatewayPostTimeout
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The amount of time in seconds to wait for a POST to the client gateway. Set by OGV.

Property.Name: CIOClientGatewayURL
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOClientGatewayURL generated by CLF

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.Name: CIOIsGet
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Indicates that thr message is a Get wiith no execute. Used for outbound messages

Property.Name: CIOListExpression
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: InSite Unified Expression

Property.Name: CIOListProcessorName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.Name: CIOOutboundMsgDef
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This Object defines the template(s) to export based on this service.

Property.Name: CIOQueryResultRows
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.Name: CIORequestData
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Request Data - result of request expressions

Property.Name: CIORequestDataExps
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Request Data Expressions are used to request data to be returned in an Outbound Response

Property.Name: CIOSendMsgToExternalSystemResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOSendMsgToExternalSystemResult is the boolean value true or false depending on execution of custom proc SendMsgToExternalSystem.

Property.Name: CIOSerialRequests
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Used to request Serialized objects in a reponse

Property.Name: CIOSerialResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOSerialResult - used as Proxy for SerialRequests

Property.Name: CIOSerialResults
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Serial Results - OGV to serialize CIOSerialRequests

Property.Name: CIOSynchTimeout
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Controls the Timeout of the Synch Response Handler

Property.Name: CIOTagData
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Tag Data from the Inbound Message to be included in the outbound message if the outbound message is a Response.

Property.Name: CIOUserQueryResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: User Query Result

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Generic String

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Holds the current week of the year (1-52)

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Employee Name

Property.Name: isFactoryName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Readable name for Factory

Property.Name: ServiceNameListItem
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Name of the (service) CDO Definition associated with this menu item. The value for this field is retrieved using the ServiceTypeDefId field.

Property.Name: SmartBarcode
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Barcode to be parsed using a Smart Scan Rule

Property.Name: SmartScanParseError
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Smart parsing from CLF will not throw an error. If any error does occur, a message will be output here. The calling CLF can decide what to do with it.

Property.Name: SmartScanRule
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Rule to use for parsing Smart Barcode

Property.Name: StrSplitResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Utility field to hold results of string split.

Property.Name: DisplayName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element. For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object. The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character. This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used. DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Unique ID for an instance of this object, generated by the system.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOClienbtGatewayPostTimeout

Property.Name: CIOClientGatewayURL
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIOClientGatewayURL generated by CLF

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: ApprovalSheetTemplate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: An approval sheet is used to collect signatures of approvers who are making decisions regarding the status of an object. The template is used to pre-define the sheets that will be attached to the object.

Property.Name: ValidChildTypes
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Valid Child Types

Property.Name: BusinessRule
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Business Rule

Property.Name: ChecklistTemplate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Checklist Template object allows the user to configure checklist items/questions and associate each item with the appropriate Response Set.

Property.Name: RuleList
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the field to which the BusinessRule data will be added.

Property.Name: Templates
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The field is used to retrieve Process Object Template and Process Model Template service names only.

Property.Name: CompletionMsg
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: When the service is executed, this field will be filled out by the system with a message in the terminology of the user and language that describes the successful completion of the service, or describes the error condition if there was an error. The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

Property.Name: Factory
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.Name: SyncName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the object that we will try and resolve so it can be synced.

Property.Name: ChangePackagesToRemove
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The list of Change Packages to be unassigned from the Modeling Instance

Property.Name: ChangePackagesToRemove-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ChangePackageToAssign
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A change package is used to manage what is delivered to a target system for consumption.

Property.Name: CIOIsSync
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO - Indicates that the Sync method is being called.

Property.Name: DataVersion
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This value is supposed to be saved on the client side and then resubmitted back to prevent conflicts caused by simultaneous updates of existing modeling entities. This field was introduced because the XMLAppServer supports only stateless services. This field should not be used in a stateful environment like DCOM AppServer.

Property.Name: ESigDetails-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: ESigRequirement
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected in a single transaction.

Property.Name: TxnDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Property.Name: WhereUsed
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: A list of this type is returned by the Where-used functionality of a maintenance service. An instance of this CDO will specify one of the objects using the object to change. The fields in this CDO are used to populate a tree view displayed while maintaining a modeling object.

Property.Name: WhereUsed-Expanded
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Expanded property for working with Key functionality.

Property.Name: WhereUsedConfig
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

Property.Name: ACEMessage
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure) On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

Property.Name: ACEStatus
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure) Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.
Value Name Meaning 1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully 2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully 3 ACEFFail an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event > 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

Property.Name: CIOMessageContents
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Message Contents from the CIO Message Service

Property.Name: CIOMessageID
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: GUID representing a CIO Message - inbound

Property.Name: Comments
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

Property.Name: EffectivityDate
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing. This value is always specified as GMT time.

Property.Name: Employee
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed. Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

Property.Name: IsRemoteService
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

Property.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Property.Name: Password
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered. If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

Property.Name: ServerName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

Property.Name: User
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation. If not input, security is based on the login user.

Property.Name: ChannelAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The Adapter to send the outbound message. Set by CVE.

Property.Name: CIOAdapter
Property.customAttribute:Annotations:
Channel Adapters provide an abstraction between the source system and the CIO Messaging System to allow the source system to send messages to the CIO Messaging System and receive messages from the CIO Messaging System without requiring the source system to directly consume the CIO endpoints. Channel Adapters provide a layer of abstraction to the external application to 'adapt' the Message Channel for convenience. Examples of Channel Adapters can be as simple as providing shared directories for passing files back and forth or as complex as accessing a source application's API to invoke the functionality inside an application necessary to retrieve and send data.
Camstar provides a standard set of Channel Adapters (e.g. ByFileAdapter), however, custom adapters can also be created for specific purposes (reference the Camstar CIO SDK).

Property.Name: CIOAdapterName
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: CIO Adapter Name

Property.Name: CIOConditionQuery
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Predefined query defined using the Web Modeler application or using the new Web UI infrastructure and stored as Instance Data. Note that the query definition is defined as instance data; the query itself can be used to retrieve information from either instance data tables or metadata tables. Field UserQueryParameters will be implemented as a persistent list so that the parameter sequence will be automatically maintained by the corresponding persistent list table.

Property.Name: CIOConditionResult
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: String list of Condition Query Results. Populated with an OGV that executes the CIOConditionQuery so that it could used in a outbound condition expression.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Indicates that thr message is a Get wiith no execute. Used for outbound messages

Property.Name: ValidChildTypes
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: Valid Child Types

Property.Name: CompletionMsg

Property.Name: Factory
Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The factory where the work was performed. The container must exist in the factory specified here. Usually this field is not input by the user.

Property.customAttribute:Annotations: The name of the object that we will try and resolve so it can be synced.
